name: new-project
description: /new-project bootstraps a repository from the claude-improvements baselines, in Claude Code or Codex: proposes the kickoff answers from your description and asks only the open ones, copies the web, Rust or Python template, writes CLAUDE.md and the stack ADR, then installs and runs verify

baselines.title: Baselines folder
baselines.description: The baselines folder of a claude-improvements checkout (it holds general/kickoff.md), as an absolute path or one starting with ~/. Leave empty when the mod runs from that checkout
